name: sonilo
description: Generate licensed music, sound effects, mixed videos, translated subtitles, and dubbing with Sonilo Platform.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Sonilo Platform account to create licensed music, sound effects, and newly mixed videos from text or public HTTPS media. Combine music and effects, keep narration clear, request multiple music variants or instrument stems, review translated subtitles before dubbing, and retrieve generation results. Eligible accounts can preview dubbing before requesting a full video. Check your current USD cash balance, available services, free-trial allowance, and usage in Codex. Generation can consume existing account credits; read-only checks do not. Features and previews depend on account access and the connected service. Sonilo.com creator accounts are separate and cannot be used with this plugin.
capabilities: Cash balance, trial allowance and usage reporting
defaultPrompt: Create 30 seconds of jazz and provide separate drums and bass tracks.
Add music and sound effects to this public HTTPS video and return a new video with clear speech.
Translate this public HTTPS video into English subtitles for me to review before dubbing.
